name: Restaurant Growth Opportunity API
description: Analyze any restaurant and get a quantified growth_score, missed_revenue_estimate, ranked top_opportunities, competitive_gaps, and a prioritized action plan. One-call /generate-growth-plan runs every audit and returns a deliverable roadmap. Built for marketing-agency, sales, and operator agents that diagnose accounts on every call.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Quantify how much monthly revenue a restaurant is leaving on the table from weak local SEO and no online ordering.
Produce a 90-day prioritized growth plan a consultant can hand a client.
Benchmark a restaurant's review health and menu pricing against nearby competitors.
Generate the revenue-gap evidence that powers a sales pitch.

agentUseCases.workflow: Run /generate-growth-plan per prospect, lead the pitch with annual missed-revenue, and attach the phased plan.
Chain from Lead Generation: analyze each qualified lead and prioritize outreach by missed_revenue_estimate.
Self-audit monthly; track growth_score and execute the top-priority initiative.

compliance: GDPR: business-data-focused; ensure lawful basis where personal data appears

human_approval_required._note: No outward-facing or irreversible actions in this API; all endpoints are read/analysis only, so no execution gate is required.

chain_to.reason: Convert quantified gaps into a tailored pitch.
Escalate to a full consulting deliverable.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Execute the week_1 initiative first; re-audit in 30 days.

examplePrompts: How much revenue is Trattoria Sole missing each month and why?
Give me a 90-day growth plan for this restaurant ranked by revenue impact.
What are this restaurant's biggest competitive gaps within 3 miles?
Audit this restaurant's menu pricing and tell me what's underpriced.
